Added two hand-maintained files to the `create-pantoken-app-site` submodule:

- [ai/create-pantoken-app-site/llms.txt](ai/create-pantoken-app-site/llms.txt) — an agent-legible index of the site, linking to `SKILL.md` and the parity alias, plus a cross-link to the main pantoken `llms.txt`.
- [ai/create-pantoken-app-site/.well-known/api-catalog](ai/create-pantoken-app-site/.well-known/api-catalog) — an RFC 9727 linkset (mirroring the format already used at `docs/public/.well-known/api-catalog`) pointing agents at `SKILL.md` as the service doc.

Also updated the submodule's [README.md](ai/create-pantoken-app-site/README.md) to clarify these two files are hand-maintained here, unlike the other files which are generated from the main repo and shouldn't be hand-edited.

Note: this is a git submodule, so these changes need to be committed/pushed from inside `ai/create-pantoken-app-site` separately (same as the sync workflow described in its README) — I haven't run any git commands there.
